parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the two switch buttons on the wall switch, made of ABS plastic, rectangular in shape, and designed to be pressed by the user.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning an electrical circuit on or off, controlling the connected device or light.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pivoting or pressing inward when actuated, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second switch button on the wall switch, also made of ABS plastic, similar in size and shape to the first switch.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional control point, often used for a separate circuit or light source.
parts.Movement_description: It moves similarly to the first switch, pressing inward to toggle the electrical connection.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate material, providing structural support for the switch buttons.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal electrical components and provides mounting support for the switch assembly on the wall.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as a fixed support structure.
